system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global near real-time CO concentration from Sentinel-5P TROPOMI sensor. The Earth Engine collection provides global atmospheric carbon monoxide measurements in clear-sky and cloudy-sky conditions.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Daily CO measurements from 2018-11-22 to present in the Earth Engine asset.
data_description.important_note: Carbon monoxide is a key atmospheric tracer for combustion processes. Main sources include fossil fuel combustion, biomass burning, and atmospheric oxidation of methane. CO has a lifetime of weeks to months, making it useful for tracking pollution transport.

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: CO column number density in mol/m^2. Use CO_column_number_density band for total atmospheric CO content.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: CO measurements are sensitive to cloud cover. Use cloud_height band to assess retrieval conditions.

data_description.data_source: European Space Agency Sentinel-5P TROPOMI mission via Google Earth Engine
